title: Hierarchical Menu - showParentLevel works only for immediate parent
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

When the `showParentLevel` prop is set to `true`, the Hierarchical Menu widget is only showing sibling categories of the selected category.

## 🔍 Bug reproduction

**Steps to reproduce the behavior:**

1. Go to https://instantsearchjs.netlify.app/stories/?path=/story/refinements-hierarchicalmenu--default
2. Click on `Appliances`
3. Click on `Fans`
4. Click on `Ceiling Fans`
5. Categories list is only showing `Fans` categories

## 💭 Expected behavior

The expected behavior is that the Hierarchical Menu widget shows sibling categories on all levels, as per comment in the https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/master/src/widgets/hierarchical-menu/hierarchical-menu.tsx#L128

## 🖥 Screenshots

Second level category selected:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6537892/169808083-a8af8b62-270f-4d5e-8881-08e09eea9466.png)

The third level category selected, all parent categories\` siblings are hidden:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6537892/169808209-fc044348-f832-4f9a-beef-886fecede7ab.png)

## Additional context

The same bug is also reproducible in `react-instantsearch`, https://react-instantsearch.netlify.app/storybook/?path=/story/hierarchicalmenu--default
